ads.headline: Your Gums Deserve The German One.
ads.signType: a huge roadside BILLBOARD beside a busy city highway, shot from the road with traffic below and sky behind
ads.brief: Bright daylight, realistic highway with cars, the billboard dominant and crystal sharp. Small LACALUT AKTIV tube + mouthwash bottle lockup in the billboard's bottom corner.
ads.label: AKTIV SIGN S1 - Billboard

ads.headline: WARNING: Most Toothpaste Forgets Your Gums.
ads.signType: a weathered yellow-and-black INDUSTRIAL WARNING / caution metal sign, distressed with rust and scratches, bolted to a wall
ads.brief: The word WARNING huge across the top in heavy black caps on yellow, the rest of the message below in bold black. Gritty realistic metal texture. Small LACALUT AKTIV tube + mouthwash bottle at the bottom of the sign.
ads.label: AKTIV SIGN S2 - Warning Sign

ads.headline: Brush For Your Gums, Not Just Your Teeth.
ads.signType: a bright yellow POST-IT NOTE stuck on the corner of a laptop screen, handwritten in marker
ads.brief: Real laptop on a desk, screen glow behind, the post-it in sharp focus with bold handwritten marker text. LACALUT AKTIV tube + mouthwash bottle sitting small beside the laptop.
ads.label: AKTIV SIGN S3 - Post-it on Screen

ads.headline: 100 Years Of German Pharmacy Gum Care.
ads.signType: a push NOTIFICATION banner popping up at the top of a phone lock screen, bold notification title text
ads.brief: Realistic phone lock screen held in hand, time and battery at top, the LACALUT notification banner bold and legible. A small LACALUT AKTIV tube + mouthwash bottle visible on a surface behind the phone.
ads.label: AKTIV SIGN S4 - Phone Notification

ads.headline: Firm, Cared-For Gums.
ads.signType: bold lettering TATTOOED across the upper BACK of a person photographed from behind in a natural candid setting
ads.brief: Candid real photo from behind, natural skin and lighting, the tattoo text large, crisp and easy to read. LACALUT AKTIV tube + mouthwash bottle resting small on a bench in the background.
ads.label: AKTIV SIGN S5 - Back Tattoo

ads.headline: German Gum Care.
ads.signType: a few words written across the FOREHEAD of a person, candid close-up portrait in a real everyday setting
ads.brief: Candid close-up of a believable everyday Australian, slight smile, the forehead text bold and clearly legible. Hold the message very short so it fits large across the forehead.
ads.label: AKTIV SIGN S6 - Forehead
